character.name: Idle
character.prompt: HD-2D JRPG pixel sprite of a slender teenage girl, about 48 pixels tall, about 3.3 heads tall. Very long light ash-beige twin tails that turn soft pink at the tips, reaching her knees. White wing-shaped hair ornaments with pink scalloped edges on both sides of the head, one large white and pink lily on the head. Pink eyes. White frilly long-sleeved dress with wide layered ruffled cuffs, short flared white skirt with a scalloped hem and a few small pink star dots, a cluster of white-pink flowers at the waist, white stockings. Selective dark outline, 2-3 tone shading, light from the top front, limited palette, no pure black.
